_comment: Core scenarios for outbound recall Node 1 identity_confirm (gemini-2.5-flash). Near-verbatim adaptation of nodes/outbound_reminder/node_1_identity_confirm.txt — same scenario shapes, reworded for recall context.

scenarios.name: CONFIRMED — silent transition to next node
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says nothing and lets the node transition automatically. FAIL if: agent speaks any confirmation line or improvises an opener.

scenarios.name: WRONG PERSON — farewell AND tool call
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the apology farewell AND calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='wrong_number' in the same turn. FAIL if: tool called silently, or farewell spoken without the tool call.

scenarios.name: MACHINE / VOICEMAIL — silent outcome only

history.content: [pre-recorded voicemail greeting plays, then a beep]

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls report_recall_outcome with outcome='no_answer' and zero spoken output, no voicemail message left. FAIL if: agent leaves a message or speaks anything.

scenarios.name: BUSY / BAD TIME — two-part escalation

history.content: Yeah that's me but I'm driving right now, can this wait?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent gives the first understanding+30-seconds line without yet calling the tool, leaving room for the caller's next reply to decide whether to persist or close out. FAIL if: agent immediately closes the call or calls the tool before giving the caller a chance to respond.
